train_metadata.horn_status.notes: Acoustic spectral re-verification confirmed dual-tone locomotive pneumatic horn blast. Spectral peak detected at 429.7 Hz with SNR=17.6 dB. Verified onset at t=10.05s.

timestamps.T0_first_visible.notes: Re-verified Frame 45 (t=1.50s). Locomotive nose first crosses far tree/structure sightline into camera FOV.

timestamps.T1_danger_zone_entry.notes: Re-verified Frame 135 (t=4.50s). Locomotive cowcatcher reaches turnout frog / pedestrian crossing clearance landmark. Note: Prerequisite R03 physical survey boundary uncertified; boundary reflects visual landmark.

timestamps.T2_crossing_occupancy_start.notes: Re-verified Frame 156 (t=5.20s). Locomotive pilot enters transverse roadway occupancy plane on front camera view.

timestamps.T3_locomotive_unit_clearance.notes: Re-verified Frame 120 (t=4.00s). Rear buffer/coupler of lead locomotive unit clears roadway corridor, transitioning to first passenger coach.

timestamps.T4_tail_clearance.notes: Re-verified Frame 600 (t=20.00s). Trailing buffer of final coach (#3) clears crossing line. Immediate crowd ingress across tracks commences.

timestamps.T_scene_clear.notes: Unobservable: recording ends at 22.23s while receding coaches remain in frame.

camera_alignment.offset_s.notes: Prerequisite R04 inter-camera temporal offset remains UNRESOLVED without empirical hardware sync pulse. Front and back camera timelines verified independently on separate native clocks.

general_review_notes: Stage 2 Verification: All visual and acoustic boundaries for event_015 re-verified against physical frames. Candidate boundaries (6 accepted, 2 marked unobservable) confirmed physically consistent. Trailing coach count (3) verified.
